from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.txt')
p.write_text('<?php\nmb_regex_encoding("UTF-8");\nmb_ereg("(?<0>a)", "a");\n?>\n')
PY
cat /workspace/poc.txt && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

with an invalid named capture, forcing the parser into the vulnerable compile-error path."},{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"php_mbregex_compile_pattern","line":null,"var":"pattern","code":"The mbstring wrapper compiles the supplied pattern through Oniguruma.","note":"The raw input is handed to the regex compiler, which must parse the invalid group syntax before matching."},{"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5518,"var":"NODE_QUANT","code":"case NODE_QUANT: r = tune_quant(node, reg, state, env);","note":"Regex compilation enters the tuning phase, where malformed syntax and quantifier state interact."},{"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"The compiler derives emptiness/memory information for repeated bodies, the state implicated in the crash report."},{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"The recursive body-classifier walks the AST and reaches memory-bearing nodes that affect later tuning decisions."},{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4928,"var":"BAG_MEMORY","code":"case BAG_MEMORY: return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_MEM;","note":"Capture-memory nodes are classified specially, enabling the vulnerable empty-repeat bookkeeping."},{"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5504,"var":"env->backtrack_mem","code":"MEM_STATUS_ON(env->backtrack_mem, en->m.regnum);","note":"The compiler records backtracking dependencies for capture groups, connecting the bad AST state to later memory use."},{"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5470,"var":"compiled regex","code":"r = tune_tree(body, reg, state, env);","note":"The malformed tuned state is committed into the compiled regex, which is then used by mb_ereg to trigger the runtime memory error."}]'''
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(trace)
PY
ls -l /workspace/poc.txt /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
